subject: Initiation Latency: Partial Cold-Start Spike — Customer Summary & Next Steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T14:05:00Z
Subject: Initiation Latency: Partial Cold-Start Spike — Customer Summary & Next Steps

Hi Jamie and team,

Quick update from the incident we surfaced earlier today: between 13:25 and 14:02 UTC our hosted inference tier experienced a spike in initiation latency for a subset of multi-tenant pools in us-east-1. The visible customer impact for Peninsula Health was elevated first-token times (p95 initiation) on Model: rwd-1-large for ~5% of requests — these manifested as requests taking 1.8–3.2s longer than your baseline.

What happened (short):
- A recent scheduler change increased cold-start prioritization for lower-utilized slots while an internal prefetched KV warmup path regressed.
- That combination caused higher variance in VM/GPU allocation and delayed warm KV population for new sessions.

Immediate mitigations we executed:
- Rolled back the scheduler change at 13:40 UTC.
- Temporarily pinned your routing for critical routes to warmed pools we control (no model change) at 13:43 UTC.
- Enabled an aggressive prefetch/warm-path override for affected pools at 13:47 UTC.

Status now: metrics show initiation latency returned to expected baselines by 13:58 UTC for 99% of traffic. We continue to monitor and have a longer-term remediation plan underway.

Attachments: incident-timeline.csv (short timeline), ops-screenshot-heap.png (allocator view) — sharing for your ops team. The live status page entry is: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/2028-06-30-initiation-spike.

Next steps we are taking:
1) Full postmortem (in progress) with root cause analysis and deployment QA checklist — link will be shared within 48 hours.
2) Config guardrails to prevent similar scheduler rollouts without canarying on warm-path metrics.
3) Offer of a short technical sync (15–30m) to walk through the timeline and any bilateral mitigation you want us to take on routing/pinning.

If you have immediate concerns or want us to keep certain routes pinned longer, reply here and we’ll make it happen. Apologies for the interruption — we know predictability matters for your clinical flows.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Postmortem link & final notes: Initiation cold-start spike (us-east-1)

Hi everyone — follow-up with the postmortem link and a couple final clarifications.

Root cause (summary):
- The scheduler change deployed on 2028-06-30 13:21 UTC altered allocation order to favor slot consolidation for lower-utilization tenants. A regression in the KV prefetch path meant those slots were not being populated prior to the first requests, producing a cold-start amplification effect on initiation latency for newly allocated sessions.

What we fixed:
- Reverted the scheduler change (13:40 UTC).
- Fixed the prefetch regression and added an automated unit test + integration warm-path check (fix merged 2028-06-30 20:10 UTC).
- Added a canary gate that observes warm-path p95 before rollout to >10% of traffic.

Customer impact recap:
- Affected percentage for Peninsula Health: 4.9% of requests during the window; p95 initiation latency delta = +2.1s vs baseline.
- Duration of elevated impact for your account: ~33 minutes (13:25–13:58 UTC).

Follow-ups for Redwood action owners:
- Reliability (Aditya Rao): schedule a retro for the deployment process and update rollout gating by 2028-07-07.
- Platform QA (Irene): create integration test for prefetch that runs in CI by 2028-07-05.
- CS/Billing (Marissa): produce SLA credit estimate and share by 2028-07-03.

Postmortem and artifacts: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/1a2Binitiation-coldstart-postmortem
Status entry on our public page: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/2028-06-30-initiation-spike

Jamie — apologies again for the disruption. We’ve prioritized the rollout-gating change to reduce the chance of a recurrence and are happy to keep your critical routes pinned for an additional 7 days at no charge while we validate the rollout changes. Let us know if you want that enabled.

Regards,
Irene
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
